item.title: Jensen Huang took a call from Trump, and showed off something else, too
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: When Jensen Huang took a live call from Trump, some of us were more focused the phone he used to take it.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Though Elon Musk and Sam Altman have supported Dario Amodei's calls to slow the pace of AI development, Jensen Huang seems to feel differently.

item.title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million, report says
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Glass Imaging was founded by a pair of former Apple engineers who previously led the team that developed Apple's Portrait Mode.

item.title: AI infrastructure company Cornelis raises $205M to chip away at Nvidia’s dominance
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: The company also announced a product called Active Compute Fabric, a network technology that targets the fact that much GPU time is wasted waiting for data to arrive.

item.title: Amazon Prime Video takes on TikTok with short-form news clips
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Prime Video is adding on-demand local and national news clips as Amazon joins other streamers experimenting with short-form video to capture younger viewers.

item.title: ClickFix attacks are tricking Mac and Windows users into hacking themselves
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: If you clicked on a fake HBO Max ad on Reddit in the past week, you might have fallen victim to a rising "ClickFix" security threat.

item.title: Volkswagen’s crazy-efficient EV borrows an idea from Slate
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Volkswagen's new efficiency-minded halo car is almost twice as efficient as the most efficient production car, the Lucid Air.

item.title: With iOS 27, I’m actually using Siri again
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Apple’s long-delayed Siri overhaul is finally here with iOS 27, and it changes how useful the assistant feels day to day.

item.title: macOS 27: new Siri takes on AI productivity apps
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The two most noticeable things about macOS 27 Golden Gate are the newly updated Siri AI and the design changes that make windows and icons more consistent.

item.title: Fashion app Daydream uses Apple Intelligence to help you shop the outfits in your camera roll
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Thanks to the launch of iOS 27, Daydream's app now includes features that can turn saved outfit photos into shoppable results and search for products through Siri without opening the app.

item.title: Microsoft’s new AI ‘code of conduct’ tells models not to hack systems or trick humans
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: The code of conduct lays out general principles that Microsoft AI models should uphold — supporting humans rather than replacing them, for instance, and accelerating human flourishing — as well as specific safety constraints meant to implement those principles.

item.title: Waymo opens robotaxi service in Las Vegas
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Las Vegas will be Waymo's 15th commercial robotaxi market.

item.title: Sources say Automattic’s board is out after failed attempt to oust CEO Matt Mullenweg
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Given that these departed board members were those who voted to put Mullenweg on a paid leave of absence to begin with, it makes sense that a board shakeup has taken place.

item.title: Only at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: What happens when OpenAI ships your roadmap?
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: If you're building an AI company, the question isn't whether foundation models will continue to evolve. It's whether your company will continue creating value as they do. Don't miss this interactive session on the Builders Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

item.title: Superhuman acquires YC-backed notetaker Fathom as productivity platforms push for agentic work
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The notetaker offers a generous free plan, and that has resulted in over 400,000 monthly active users. The company said that over 1 million people have recorded meetings until now.

item.title: Hear how AI can engineer nature’s comeback at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Not long ago, bringing an extinct species back to life belonged to science fiction. Today, it's the mission of a billion-dollar startup. Join the conversation with one of tech's most unconventional founders. Secure your Disrupt pass today.

item.title: 5 days left to exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: The last day to apply for an exhibit table at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 on Sept 18. Just 5 days left. Secure your spot on the Expo Hall floor and put your business in front of 10,000+ founders, investors, and tech leaders.

item.title: A Vinyl Bar in Shibuya is a startup from a former Spotify leader for making music apps
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Former Spotify exec's company releases experimental "singles" that involves users in music making.

item.title: Insight Partners’ Deven Parekh on why the firm is diversifying while everyone else bets the farm on OpenAI and Anthropic
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Insight Partners' Devin Parekh opens up about losing Legora to General Catalyst, why he's fine holding stakes in rival AI labs, and why — even as everyone else piles into OpenAI and Anthropic — his $90 billion firm is deliberately staying diversified.

item.title: Larry Ellison cancels $7.5 billion sale of Oracle stock
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: Oracle had previously disclosed that Ellison planned to sell 50 million shares worth around $7.5 billion.
